professionalSummary.text: Has been tech lead for an engineering team, holding technical decisions and release sign-off for its services.
professionalSummary.witness: Software engineer from 2019, then tech lead from 2022 to 2024, on the claims API team at Pemberton Mutual, a team of six engineers.

experienceHighlights.text: Designed and versions REST APIs for insurance products.
experienceHighlights.witness: Designed the first-notice-of-loss API and its versioning scheme, recording each choice in an architecture decision record that the candidate wrote and the team accepted.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Led incident response and wrote post-incident reviews.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Acted as incident commander for two severity-one outages in 2023 and wrote both post-incident reviews, naming an owner and a deadline for each corrective action.

skills.text: Works with application security to remediate vulnerabilities.
skills.witness: Worked with the application-security team to clear 41 dependency vulnerabilities flagged by the scanner, spreading the fixes over three sprints and recording each fix in the remediation tracker.
